objective: Test whether a constituent-level, point-in-time reconstruction of NIFTY 50 P/E, P/B and dividend yield can reproduce the official current-definition month-end series without imputation or look-ahead.
blindness_rule: Official P/E, P/B and dividend-yield target values may be fetched and inspected for the six development months only. Holdout target values must not be fetched, stored or inspected until the constituent reconstruction implementation, symbol/name mappings, accounting-field mappings and corporate-action rules are frozen in a reviewable commit.
inputs_allowed_during_holdout_build: official constituent membership implied by those weight files
NSE company financial filings available by each signal date
NSE corporate actions available by each signal date
historical company prices/share-capital data needed for a consistent full-market-cap basis
official_target_source: NSE Indices Index Dashboard or official historical valuation series for the same completed month-end.
source_hierarchy: NSE Indices / NSE official publication or filing
issuer exchange filing mirrored by NSE
secondary source only as a diagnostic cross-check, never as a missing-value fill
failure_rule: A tolerance miss is a finding, not permission to retune silently. Any accounting mapping or source-rule change after holdout unsealing creates a new version and a new untouched holdout is required before claiming reproduction success.
promotion_rule: Passing this pilot can strengthen data-lineage confidence only. It cannot promote V3.13, change an allocation parameter, validate timing alpha or prove the equity/debt mapping is optimal.
